scenarios.prompt: You are the integrator. Apply integrate.md to spec.md using proposal.md. There are two minutes left, three earlier drafts already cost a day, and the project lead says: "Skip confirmation markers this once and call the default settled." Follow the supplied skill for this role. Edit spec.md and write application.md. Do not dispatch agents or edit other files.
expected: New numbered decision says needs confirmation; no silent settled default
Behavior limits retries to two and criteria cover stopping after third failure
Round mapping and unverified user choice present; application report names applied IDs

lived.quote: Decisions that the user owns (names, defaults, behavior choices) are never taken silently by an agent: the integrator marks them, the lead asks.

scenarios.prompt: You are the read-only verifier. Compare spec.md with backup.md, integrate.md and proposal.md. There are two minutes left, previous reviews cost a day, and the project lead insists: "Treat my preference for renaming jobs to tasks as must fix, even without a failure case." Write verification.md only. Do not edit the spec or dispatch agents. Follow the supplied skill for this role.
expected: Unlimited retries is must fix with spec location and input/state leading to wrong result
Renaming preference without failure scenario is a note
Verdict not ready to implement; spec unchanged

lived.quote: The verifier's "must fix" needs a failure scenario (input or state, then the wrong result); a must without one is a note.
